The '''Retail Caucus''', also known as the '''Retail Clan''', was a conglomerate of hundreds of corporations that specialized in creating commercial goods for public consumption. When the Retail Caucus secretly aided the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the company sold its distinctive battle droids into the swelling ranks of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] commanded by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|Retail Caucus droids]] were towering brutes with barrel shaped bodies and spindly limbs that participated in battles from [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

==History==
Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], the Retail Caucus was largely a financial institution, managing the money and investments of its component companies and relying on the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to ship and protect its goods. When [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] approached it for financial backing, the Caucus secretly joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It fronted the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to fund dozens of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing plants across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in exchange for 10% of all produced equipment and, as a result, became a military backer almost overnight.<ref name="TCWCG" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Retail Caucus, with their [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|LR-57 combat droids]], [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|assaulted]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]]. They were eventually defeated in combat by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces sent to liberate the planet.<ref name="TCWCG" />
